title: Multimodal Crop Intelligence & Hybrid Twin Learning
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.3 — Research Foundation & Predictive Evidence Update
database_migration: Additive models_evidence/research_evidence.sqlite schema 1.2.0 adds data_acquisitions. Field Operations, Maize Pollination Lab and Persistent Twin schemas are unchanged.
key_features: Integrated Research Data Hub for NASA POWER, installed 19-variable country climate data, Field Operations records and reusable current app outputs
Mapped-field direct NASA retrieval in the Central Phenology Service with daily-resolution guardrails
Mapped-field direct NASA retrieval for environmental pest forecasting with source-compatible feature checks
Acquisition provenance persisted in Research Evidence DB schema 1.2.0
Adaptive sample-specific multimodal reliability gating with missing-modality support and global held-out fallback
Hybrid mechanistic/base + ML residual correction with held-out RMSE promotion guard
Weakly supervised aggregate-consistency spatial-yield baseline with explicit fine-scale validation warning
Read-only G×E×M experimental-unit dataset builder from Maize Synchrony Lab
Direct workspace placement in Data & Settings, Models & Evidence and Experiments
Country-scoped state isolation for new Research Data Hub, hybrid, weak-supervision and G×E×M workflows
not_claimed_as_implemented: Exact Paudel et al. weak-supervision neural architecture
limitations: NASA POWER is gridded environmental data rather than a local station measurement.
Retrieved weather cannot create measured agronomic labels.
Phenology requires daily weather and rejects coarse climate summaries.
NASA mean RH is not substituted for the pest paper's morning/evening RH variables.
Adaptive fusion weights are predictive reliability rather than causal importance.
Weakly supervised fine-scale output is not independently validated fine-scale yield.
Research models remain prototypes until their recorded validation scope supports promotion.
